description: A React component for displaying system analytics and statistics in the Mattermost admin console, including charts, counts, and plugin data.

classes.name: SystemAnalytics
classes.description: React component for rendering system analytics dashboard with charts, counts, and plugin stats.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches standard and advanced analytics, plugin stats, and server limits on component mount.

methods.name: loadLineChartData
methods.description: Loads line chart data for posts, bot posts, and users per day.

methods.name: handleLineChartsToggle
methods.description: Handles toggling of the detailed statistics section, loading data if not already loaded.

methods.name: fetchPluginStats
methods.description: Fetches plugin-specific analytics data for display.

methods.name: getStatValue
methods.description: Extracts numeric value from various stat data formats.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the analytics dashboard with charts, counts, banners, and plugin data.
